nl_Literal_translation_en: From 2 to 10 seconds from now, the ego vehicle speed shall remain less than or equal to the applicable speed limit.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从现在起第 2 秒到第 10 秒之间，自车速度应始终小于或等于当前适用限速。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the speed-compliance window from the second through the tenth second, the vehicle shall not exceed the applicable speed limit.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在第 2 秒至第 10 秒的限速合规窗口内，车辆不得超过当前适用限速。
